items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The tune with Horace Silver? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: It was an arrangement of “The Preacher.” Do you remember that a long time ago?
Yeah. There was one with clarinet that was for Benny for that show.
